title: Align Beadle's preference and bundle identifier
objective: Ship Beadle under the la.maquina application identifier and ensure its stored preferences and Homebrew cask cleanup target that same domain before the notarized v0.1.3 release.
acceptance_criteria: The bundle identifier and preference suite use la.maquina.BeadsStatusBar.
The Homebrew cask's zap stanza removes the matching la.maquina preference file.
swift build, maquina contract validate, maquina policy check, and git diff --check pass.
